review.body: { let operation = cli_common :: observation :: scope ("HOST" , "sig:design:storage" , "server_error" , & frame . kind) ; let bytes = frame . payload . expose_bytes () ; let mut severity = None ; let mut code = None ; let mut rest = bytes ; let mut valid = false ; while let Some ((& field , tail)) = rest . split_first () { if field == 0 { valid = tail . is_empty () ; break ; } let Some (end) = tail . iter () . position (| byte | * byte == 0) else { break ; } ; let value = & tail [.. end] ; match field { b'V' => { if severity . replace (value) . is_some () { break ; } } b'C' => { if code . replace (value) . is_some () { break ; } } _ => () , } rest = & tail [end + 1 ..] ; } let code = code . filter (| code | valid && code . len () == 5 && code . iter () . all (| byte | byte . is_ascii_digit () || byte . is_ascii_uppercase ())) ; let cause = match code { Some (b"08P01" | b"0L000" | b"0LP01" | b"55P02" | b"55P04") => Cause :: StatementRejected , Some (b"25006") => Cause :: ReadOnly , Some (b"25P03" | b"25P04" | b"55P03" | b"57014" | b"57P05") => Cause :: Cancelled , Some (b"40002") => Cause :: ConstraintViolation , Some (b"42501") => Cause :: PermissionDenied , Some (b"57P01" | b"57P02" | b"57P03") => Cause :: Unavailable , Some (b"XX001" | b"XX002") => Cause :: StorageDamaged , Some (code) => match & code [.. 2] { b"03" | b"09" | b"0A" | b"0B" | b"0F" | b"0Z" | b"10" | b"20" | b"21" | b"22" | b"24" | b"26" | b"27" | b"2B" | b"2D" | b"2F" | b"34" | b"38" | b"39" | b"3B" | b"44" | b"54" | b"HV" | b"P0" | b"25" | b"42" => { Cause :: StatementRejected } b"08" => Cause :: Unavailable , b"0L" => Cause :: PermissionDenied , b"0P" | b"3D" | b"3F" | b"F0" | b"55" => Cause :: Misconfigured , b"23" => Cause :: ConstraintViolation , b"28" => Cause :: LoginRejected , b"40" => Cause :: Conflict , b"53" => Cause :: Resources , b"57" => Cause :: Terminated , b"58" | b"XX" => Cause :: ServerFault , _ => Cause :: Unrecognized , } , None => Cause :: Unrecognized , } ; let uncertain_code = code . is_some_and (| code | code == b"40003" || (code . starts_with (b"08") && code != b"08P01")) ; let result = if valid && severity == Some (b"ERROR" . as_slice ()) && ! uncertain_code { ServerError :: Failed (cause) } else { ServerError :: Uncertain (cause) } ; operation . finish (& result) ; result }
review.item_premise: One registered borrow reads severity and code only; configured limits use Resources, including 53400. No diagnostic content leaves the borrow; malformed framing cannot assert the failing transaction did not commit.
